result:
The sequence is 9, x, 81, so x is the average of the endpoints: (9 + 81)/2 = 45.

Solution A computes the common difference as 72/2 = 36 and adds it to 9, which gives 45. That is correct.

Solution B sets up the equations correctly but makes an error. Adding x − 9 = d and 81 − x = d gives 72 = 2d, not 2x, because the x terms cancel. So its answer of 36 is wrong.

WINNER: A
